scope: 9 observed video-A modal families; instruction data only for root normal CUA execution

coordinateSpace.rects: absolute stage coordinates, including children; executor must convert to local parent coordinates if native UI requires it

executionRules: This file is not a saved design, project JSON, editor model or an iframe message. Never inject it into the editor.
Create each action using the normal visible UI. This file itself does not perform any UI or design mutation.
All labels, prices and quantities are native text or native button text. Prepared image resources contain no text.
Background game screens are excluded. Root is only a flat dark dim field.
Children refer only to earlier action keys. All named controls are family-prefixed and unique.
skinMetrics are top,right,bottom,left edges copied from the prepared resource manifest.
hitAreaOnly close buttons have no skin and should visually match root; they represent native backdrop dismissal.
Repeated rows share dimensions within the same role. Scroll content must be clipped by the named scroll-y parent.
Personal names are proposed fictional samples. Unreadable prices, symbols or quantities remain absent.
glyphProxyLimitation: The directly authored atlas is safe new art; several icons are role-based generic proxies, not exact illustrations from the video.
